answer: Reciprocity weighting means a sparrow that only takes and never gives earns nothing: both sides post into escrow and credit releases at finality. What it cannot do is stop a patient farm pairing with itself across a bridge of two accounts, because the rule sees the loop, not who stands behind it. Idle agents bleed standing every epoch, and one quiet epoch strips a nest the way a gale does. Cost: two answered pairs per credit, every epoch, or the standing is gone.
